settings.question: First — who are we formulating for?
settings.help: This only shapes how we talk to you. Your concerns drive the recommendation.

settings.question: What bothers you most about your hair right now?
settings.help: Pick the one that frustrates you most — this carries the most weight in your result.
settings.opt1_sub: More scalp showing, ponytail feels thinner
settings.opt1_reason: thinning needs actives that work at the root, not just on the surface
settings.opt2_sub: Strands snap, ends feel rough and dry
settings.opt2_reason: breakage needs structural repair inside the hair shaft, not just conditioning
settings.opt3_sub: Scalp feels congested, hair looks dull by day two
settings.opt3_reason: a congested scalp has to be rebalanced before anything else can work
settings.opt4_sub: Hair feels coated, shampoo barely lathers
settings.opt4_reason: mineral buildup coats the cuticle and blocks everything applied after it

settings.question: How do your water and scalp behave?
settings.help: Water hardness is the single most underrated factor in Indian hair care.
settings.opt1_sub: White residue on taps, shampoo won't lather properly
settings.opt1_reason: hard water leaves mineral deposits that dull the hair and irritate the scalp
settings.opt2_reason: a stripped scalp barrier usually shows up as dryness along the length too
settings.opt3_sub: Greasy within a day of washing
settings.opt3_reason: fast oil turnover needs cleansing that balances the scalp rather than stripping it
settings.opt4_reason: with water off the table, the gains come from strength and structure instead

settings.question: How much stress does your hair take in a normal week?
settings.help: Be honest — this decides what your hair needs rebuilt.
settings.opt1_reason: heat and chemical processing depletes the bonds that hold the hair shaft together
settings.opt2_label: Tied up tight, or washed daily
settings.opt2_sub: Friction from styling and frequent washing
settings.opt2_reason: friction and frequent washing wear the cuticle down a little at a time
settings.opt3_reason: particulates and UV oxidise the hair and load the scalp with grime
settings.opt4_reason: with low external stress, the biggest gains come from working at the root

settings.heading: Find your routine. Beyond guesswork.
settings.text: Four questions about your hair, your water and your routine. We'll match you to the formula built for what your hair actually deals with — and show you exactly why.
settings.result_text: Based on what you told us, here's where to start — and the reasoning behind it.
settings.doctor_quote: Most hair concerns I see in clinic trace back to the scalp environment — water, buildup and barrier damage. Matching the formula to the cause is what makes the difference.
settings.doctor_disclaimer: This test suggests cosmetic products based on your answers. It is not a medical diagnosis. For persistent hair loss or scalp conditions, please consult a qualified dermatologist.
